title: Canonical-Reference Embedding Validation Runner (synthetic+prod replay)
creator: Aisha Patel
overview: Build a reusable validation runner that evaluates embedding + rerank model variants against a canonical reference corpus assembled from production traffic slices and synthetic perturbations. The runner must produce offline metrics (semantic recall, precision@k, mean reciprocal rank, embedding cosine stability, distribution shifts), store per-run artifacts, and emit alerts when regressions or drift are detected.
goals: 1) Provide a nightly and pre-deploy evaluation pipeline for embedding model candidates and quantized variants. 2) Surface deterministic offline signals that correlate with downstream rerank quality. 3) Track temporal drift for production slices and notify on significant distribution changes or metric regressions.
non_goals: Real-time in-prod inference blocking is out of scope. The runner will not replace live canaries or A/B experiments; it augments them with offline signal and faster turnaround for model onboarding decisions.
design_decisions:
- Use a compact canonical reference corpus (CR corpus) that includes: a) recent high-traffic queries, b) human-labeled relevance pairs (sampled), and c) synthetic perturbations (typos, paraphrases, truncations).
- Run candidate models head-to-head against the production baseline; compute paired metrics and bootstrapped confidence intervals.
- Persist per-run artifacts (embeddings, rank lists, metric snapshots) to S3 with a consistent naming convention and lifecycle policy.
- Integrate with existing telemetry backends (Datadog + internal metric store) for metric dashboards and alerts.
- Keep the pipeline configurable (batch size, max sequence length, quantization variant) so component owners can reproduce edge-case regressions.
acceptance_criteria:
- Nightly runner completes for all supported model variants within the allowed window (default: 60 minutes) for the CR corpus.
- Runner emits the following metrics for each model candidate: semantic_recall@10, MRR@10, precision@1, mean_cosine_stability, embedding_l2_histogram, and KL divergence for embedding distributions vs baseline.
- A human-readable report (HTML or Markdown) is published to the artifacts bucket and linked in the run metadata.
- Regression alert fires when any primary metric drops >5% with p<0.05 compared to baseline (configurable).
- A documented runbook for investigating alerts is published and linked from the runner UI.
- Unit and integration tests cover synthetic dataset generation, metric computation, and artifact upload; e2e smoke test added to CI pipeline.
tasks: 1) Design canonical reference corpus schema and sampling tooling. 2) Implement synthetic perturbation generator and labeling import adapters. 3) Build runner orchestration (Airflow / Argo) to run candidate vs baseline. 4) Implement metric computation library with bootstrap CI. 5) Persist artifacts + implement artifact retriever. 6) Dashboard + alert integration. 7) Add CI e2e smoke tests and gated predeploy check. 8) Run onboarding for 2 model families and iterate on thresholds.

risks_and_mitigation:
- Risk: Synthetic perturbations may not reflect user behavior and cause false positives. Mitigation: include production replay slices and calibrate synthetic severity against labeled failures.
- Risk: Large CR corpus churn causes long runner times. Mitigation: implement incremental evaluation + sampling stratification and cold-start cache.
- Risk: Metric thresholds mis-tuned. Mitigation: require human sign-off for P0 alerts for the first 4 weeks; track alert precision/recall.
qa_plan:
- Unit tests for metric functions and synthetic generator.
- Integration tests that run the runner on a small CR corpus in CI with mocked storage and model shim.
- Nightly stability job that verifies runner completes under the SLA.
- Review of produced reports by PM + Research for first three releases.
rollout_plan: 1) Alpha: run nightly on dev models and store artifacts (2 weeks). 2) Beta: add two production model families; surface dashboards and non-blocking alerts (4 weeks). 3) GA: enable regression alerts for PM/infra and require pre-deploy report for model promotion (after successful Beta).
investigation_notes: Observed a consistent 3-4% drop in precision@1 for the quantized-int8 variant on paraphrase-heavy slices. Follow-up: run targeted adversarial paraphrase set and collect top-K rerank differences. Assigned to ML fragility squad for root-cause.
